units.title: Introduction to Control Systems. 1.a Describe the history and significance of control system in engineering. 1.b Describe Open loop and c...
topics: 1.1. Brief Historical development of control system, James watt’s fly ball governor, Need for control system, Types.
1.2. Open loop and closed loop control system with block diagram, definition.
1.3. Control system components: actuator, feedback, controller and sensor.
1.4. Comparison: Open loop and closed loop control systems. 1.e Explain open loop control system with example. 1.f Explain close loop control system with example.

1.6. Example of closed loop control system: temperature control system, water level control system, position control system. 1.g Classify control system with an example.

units.title: Mathematical modeling of control system.
topics: 2.1. Laplace transform: Significance, Basic Laplace transform theorem

2.3. Definition: Transfer function, poles and zeros.
2.4. Poles and Zeros location in S-Plane.

topics: 3.1. Rules: summing point, tack-off point, blocks in cascade, blocks in parallel, moving take off point, moving summing point, interchanging two summing points, eliminating forward loop, eliminating of summing point in closed loop and eliminating unity feedback control system.

units.title: Performance
topics: 4.1. Error signal analysis using block diagram. Modern Control Technology Course Code: 4342405 above level) Topics and Sub-topics of feedback control system.

4.3. Input test signals: Step, Ramp, Parabolic and Impulse signal.

4.8. Mars rover control system with and without feedback.
4.9. Hubble space telescope pointing system with reduce block diagram, system design and system response to unit step.

4.d. Describe Time response of first order control system using Unit- impulse and Unit-Step Response with sketches.
4.e. Describe time response of second order control system
4.f. Define various specification of transient response of control system with example.
4.g. Explain steady state error of feedback control system.
